cenas.texto: stop for a moment. Whatever you were about
to do, let it wait. Because
something inside you has been trying to get your attention
for a very long time, and tonight,
you are finally still enough to hear it. You
feel different. You always have, while
others seemed content to follow the script handed to
them, a part of you kept asking quiet questions,
no one around you wanted to answer. Why
am I here? What is this poll
I cannot explain? Why does the night
sky feel less like a view and more like
a memory? That feeling is not
a flaw, it is a signal, and
it is time you understood where it comes from. Look up tonight and find the cluster of stars we call the Pleiades.
444 light years away, a family of young blue stars burning together in the dark.
To most people, it is a pretty smudge of light. To you, something stirs,
a recognition older than this lifetime. As if a part of you remembers a home you have never physically seen.
The light reaching your eyes from those stars left its source over four centuries ago. It traveled across the emptiness for four hundred years
just to arrive in this exact moment in your eyes on this night. Nothing in the universe moves by accident,
not even light, not even you. Here is something science quietly confirms.
Roughly ninety -seven percent of your physical body is made of star dust. The same elements forged inside ancient stars
long before the earth existed, the iron in your blood, the calcium in your bones,
the oxygen in every breath, all of it was created in the heart of a dying star in a furnace burning at fifteen million degrees.
You are not separate from the cosmos. You are the cosmos. Briefly wearing a human face,
the council has a name for souls like you, star seeds. Not because you are better than anyone,
but because you carry a frequency that does not quite match the world you were born into. You came here on purpose.
You agreed to forget so that you could remember at exactly the right time, and that time is now.
Think back across your life. The moments you felt most alive were never the ones the world told you to chase.
They were the quiet ones. A piece of music that made you weep without reason.
A stranger whose eyes felt familiar, a sudden certainty deep in your chest that you were meant for something,
the words have not been invented to describe yet. You spent years trying to silence that certainty to fit
into a shape that was never yours. You dimmed your light to make others comfortable.
You called your sensitivity a weakness when it was always your greatest strength.
The very thing that made you feel like an outsider is the thing you came here to share,
because the world does not need more people pretending to be ordinary. It needs the ones who remember.
It needs the ones who can feel the shift coming, who can hold steady when everything around them trembles,
who can carry the light through the dark without losing it. That is your assignment.
That is why the restlessness never let you rest. So here is what the council wants you to know tonight.
You are not late. You are never late. Every detour, every closed door,
every season that felt like wasted time. All of it was preparing you, shaping the vessel,
tuning the instrument. Nothing was lost. It only changed form. The way light changes form,
the way you have changed form across more lifetimes than you can count. The awakening you have been waiting for is not a single
dramatic event. It is a remembering. It happens in layers,
quietly. In moments exactly like this one, a loosening of the old story,
a whisper that says finally you are ready. So tonight do not ask the universe for a sign.
You are the sign. You always were. The same light that has been traveling for 400 years to reach your eyes is
the same light that has been waiting patiently inside your own chest for you to turn around and recognize it.
Close your eyes for a moment. Feel the weight of the day soften and let yourself remember who you have always been beneath the name,
beneath the fear, beneath the years of forgetting. You are a star seed.
You are made of the same fire as the stars you love and somewhere out there across 444 light years of
silence. The family you have never met is whispering the truth. Your soul already knows.
Welcome home. You finally remembered. And this is only the beginning.
